rule: A row is 'met' only with an evidence path that exists in the repository. Progress is criteria met of criteria total, per PS row; no percentage of the product is ever derived from this file.

rows.criterion: a named place resolves to a source-backed point or station and the distance is stated
the reading carries the retrieval time and the source for every value
a cold read completes within a stated bound and the bound is measured
coverage is stated per product, not implied nationwide
an unfamiliar request that mixes two products is answered with both or explicitly refused
a continuation keeps place, window and source without restating them
a capability question is answered from the ledger, not from memory
every answered turn carries a task-coverage record asserted in a test
each served model product names its source, run reference and answering cell
a comparison states shared lineage instead of implying independence
a forecast value can be traced to the archived run used to verify it
a live changed edition produces a notification on a real device

rows.criterion: the acknowledgement returns to the ledger
an update and a cancellation each behave
origin authentication is established or the product continues to refuse dissemination and says why
a district advisory is retrieved with printed geography, issue date and currency
a conditional statement in a general section is reconciled with the crop passage or disclosed
an unheld layout is quarantined rather than parsed
a field-level decision is refused in words
cross-edition contradiction is reconciled or disclosed
every offered language has a recorded delivery measurement per direction
a rendering that fails the invariant check keeps the source language and says so
a native speaker has accepted a sample per script

rows.criterion: the interface itself is localised (labels, dates, numerals)
a trend states its period, source and method and refuses attribution
district boundaries are dated or the analysis names the uncertainty
a chart is reproducible from its own receipt
a noisy or code-mixed recording transcribes with a confirm-before-send step
spoken output is measured, not assumed
a field user completes a journey without a keyboard

rows.criterion: each connected source has answered a real request in a recorded journey (29 sources)
the model plans every turn and supplies no value; every fact carries a source id
a sustained run records queue depth, stalls and recovery on a fresh machine
the gate runs on every push (CI)
rows.note: Added 20 Sep 2026 and green on this repository. Runs the full gate on every push and pull request: Python 3.9 (the version the demo machine runs), the frontend built before the React audits so they audit something rather than skipping, typecheck, 64 frontend suites and the 20-step gate. It has already caught two real defects a laptop hid - a test that passed only because this machine had API keys, and a stale README count.
